Always pass an ABSOLUTE sqlite path in a Python one-liner. A relative one resolved somewhere unexpected and produced a self-contradicting read.

iteration_shape: One unit of work per firing, sized to finish inside the turn, ending pushed. Prefer a small finished thing to a large half-thing — half a thing is what dies badly. Tick a tasks.md box ONLY for something you actually ran and saw pass. A section of the change (say, S1 section 1, or S1 section 2) is about the right size. Run `cd hub && py -3.11 -m pytest tests/ -q` before claiming any Hub work is done; it takes several minutes, so start it early in the turn rather than at the end.
heartbeat_note: While an iteration is working, keep last_heartbeat at now — that is what stops the driver and a live session both writing this branch. As the LAST act of an iteration, after everything is pushed, set it ~40 minutes in the past and commit that one-line change, so the next firing takes over instead of standing down against a heartbeat nobody is refreshing.
